stories.story: Mina held a moon atlas, and she wanted to sketch craters. Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not find the whale book. Jun saw the star bookmark on the high shelf. Ms Alvarez saved the moon atlas for Mina. Ms Alvarez used the ladder to lift the whale book down. Ms Alvarez gave Jun the whale book. Jun opened the whale book, and Mina and Jun read together.
